```yaml
name: Sync AI Connector Docs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  sync-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout airbyte-repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
        with:
          path: airbyte-repo

      - name: Checkout airbyte-ai-connectors-repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
        with:
          repository: airbytehq/airbyte-ai-connectors
          path: airbyte-ai-connectors-repo

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.8'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install octavia-cli peter-evans/create-pull-request

      - name: Sync docs
        run: |
          DEST_DIR=airbyte-repo/docs/ai-agents/connectors/
          rm -rf "$DEST_DIR"
          mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"

          for DIR in airbyte-ai-connectors-repo/*; do
            if [ -d "$DIR" ]; then
              cp -r "$DIR"/*.md "$DEST_DIR"
            fi
          done

      - name: Check for changes
        id: check-changes
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code "$DEST_DIR"

      - name: Create PR if changes detected
        if: steps.check-changes.outcome == 'failure'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "Sync AI connector docs"
          title: "Sync AI connector docs"
          body: "Automatically synced AI connector docs from airbyte-ai-connectors"
          labels: "documentation,auto-merge"
          branch: sync-ai-connector-docs
```
